title: DNA binding domain undergoes dynamic and selective protein–protein interactions to facilitate CTCF insulation
authors: Zhou Rong; Tian Kai; Huang Jie; Duan Wenjia; Fu Hongye; Feng Ying; Wang Hui; Jiang Yongpeng; Li Yuanjun; Wang Rui; Hu Jiazhi; Ma Hanhui; Qi Zhi; Ji Xiong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CTCF DNA结合域通过动态选择性蛋白-蛋白互作实现绝缘功能，涉及蛋白-DNA互作体系但未聚焦TF-DNA结合建模，方法以成像实验为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟，故评6分。
abstract: CTCF is required for three-dimensional chromatin organization and a predominant insulator protein. However, its roles in insulating enhancers have not been fully explained in 3D nuclear organization. Here, we found that the CTCF DNA binding domain (DBD) forms dynamic self-interacting clusters. We next investigated the spatial relationships between these clusters and other transcription regulators with a light-induced imaging system. Strikingly, CTCF DBD clusters were found to incorporate other insulator proteins but are not coenriched with transcriptional activators in the nucleus. This property is not observed in other domains of CTCF or the DBDs of other transcription factors. Moreover, endogenous CTCF shows a phenotype consistent with the DBD by forming small protein clusters and interacts less transcriptional activators bound, CTCF motif arrays. Our results reveal an interesting phenomenon that CTCF DBD interacts with insulator proteins and selectively localizes to nuclear positions with lower concentrations of transcriptional activators, providing new insights into the insulation function of CTCF.
abstract_zh: CTCF是三维染色质组织所必需的，并且是一种主要的绝缘子蛋白。然而，其在三维核组织中绝缘增强子的作用尚未被完全阐明。在此，我们发现CTCF的DNA结合域（DBD）形成动态的自相互作用簇。我们随后利用光诱导成像系统研究了这些簇与其他转录调控因子之间的空间关系。引人注目的是，CTCF DBD簇被发现能整合其他绝缘子蛋白，但在核内不与转录激活因子共富集。这一特性在CTCF的其他结构域或其他转录因子的DBD中并未观察到。此外，内源性CTCF通过形成小蛋白簇表现出与DBD一致的表型，并且与结合的转录激活因子及CTCF基序阵列的相互作用较少。我们的结果揭示了一个有趣的现象：CTCF DBD与绝缘子蛋白相互作用，并选择性地定位于转录激活因子浓度较低的核位置，为CTCF的绝缘功能提供了新的见解。
